title: Smart Data Models - Honey Harvest
description: A honey harvest (extraction) operation, linking the resulting honey lot to the beehives it comes from for traceability and labelling

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be HoneyHarvest

dateHarvested.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Date and time when the honey was extracted from the frames

lotNumber.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Lot number assigned to the harvested honey for labelling and traceability

weight.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'kilogram (KGM)'. Net weight of the extracted honey

moistureContent.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'C62'. Water content of the honey as a ratio between 0 and 1, a key quality parameter

botanicalOrigin.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Declared botanical origin of the honey, either monofloral (plant species) or multifloral

anyOf.description: Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity

hasApiary.description: Relationship. Reference to the Apiary where the honey was harvested

anyOf.description: Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity

hasBeehive.description: Relationship. References to the Beehives whose frames were extracted in this harvest
